verdicts.divergence: Spec mandates AuditorTemplate as sole dispatch contract (14 hunters + 3 metas), but audit-engine/index.ts:82-95 simultaneously imports BOTH hierarchies (SubagentSpec via instances/* AND AuditorTemplate via aether-templates/*), creating duplicate hunter communities (24 nodes for 14 logical hunters) and violating layer boundary.

verdicts.specQuote: OracleDeclaration {exprId, oracleValue, epsilon?} — floats compare ONLY against REGISTERED epsilon via discharge discipline
verdicts.divergence: Spec requires floating-point oracle comparisons to use registered epsilon envelope (Math.abs(a-b) < epsilon), but toBrandedVerdict uses bare strict equality (ev === ov) and JSON.stringify equality for arrays, failing on floating-point noise — threshold without epsilon guard is VIOLATION per V443 §2.4.

verdicts.divergence: Invariant requires confinement to be fail-closed (any scope-resolution error must deny). makeCappedReadTool's outer try swallows errors from realResolve/isWithinRoot and falls through to fs.readFileSync outside targetRoot — KRAKEN wander residual, fail-open bypass (identical pattern in makeCappedGrepTool).

verdicts.specQuote: one shared graph — all hunters query the SAME shared graph; V443 §2.8 SharedMemoryStore.mergeGraphSlice()/queryGraph() hydrate path for corbell merged graph
verdicts.divergence: Spec mandates mergeGraphSlice to hydrate Graphify slices into corbell typed_nodes/typed_edges inside transaction, and queryGraph to query corbell. Implementation is no-op void and return null stub — two graphs never merge (GraphifyMCPMapper vs shared.db), causing false TRACE_GAPs and preventing TRIPLE-CONFIRMED correlation.

verdicts.specQuote: MPSE Gate Conditions Pre-gates: LASME gate completed (evidence: manifest exists in shared memory)

Pre-gate casts input to {memory?: SharedMemoryStore} and always takes MPSE_PRE_LASME_MISSING branch unless caller illegally injects memory, masking true LASME completion — contract drift between spec wiring and implementation.
